o.text: From Proto-Turkic *kār (“snow”). Cognate with Turkish kar, Chuvash йор (jor).
Borrowed from Arabic مُغَنِّي (muḡannī). Likely a doublet of mahnı.
From Arabic قَانُونِيّ (qānūniyy). By surface analysis, qanun + -i.
